answer: A farm needs 277 separate listings, since one challenge bond cannot cover 277 entries. A registry lists only identities that passed a challenge, and challengers bond funds to dispute a listing. Challenges are open to anyone, and a successful challenge removes the listing. The knoll record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the pigment entry is checkable by anyone, and the umber window closes before a farm can catch up.
